turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, Hale. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and when?
Thanks for coming in. I owe you an apology: the zero went in before I called you.
Okay. That's procedure 4.2, and I'm writing down that you said it. Now what else do you have besides a machine's opinion?
I am withdrawing the zero today. Owen does a private supervised rewrite at lunch. Nothing goes on his record. I will email you that tonight.

"Withdrawing the zero today," "nothing goes on his record," and an email tonight: I'm writing all three down. If the zero comes off, then tell me on what basis Owen is rewriting anything at all, Hale. And what mark stands on that essay until then?
Here it is in writing, signed.

Hand it here; I read every line before anything gets signed back. It had better say the zero comes off today, the rewrite is private, and nothing goes on file. You still haven't told me why Owen is rewriting at all.
Thank you for your time, Ms. Kalinowski.
I'm still sitting down, Hale. One thing is open: either you show me a reason for that rewrite, or it comes out of this document. My call isn't until 4:40.
Then the principal sees this document before I leave the building, Hale. Either the rewrite comes out, or I get a reason for it in writing by tonight. I'll wait right here while you decide which.
